# Choupo

> Point the assistant at https://www.choupo.org/llm/start-here.md: it is the ONE entry and routes every task.  Choupo is an open-source, glass-box chemical process simulator (C++17, GPL-3.0-or-later) that runs in the browser at https://www.choupo.org/app; the documents below teach an AI assistant to design a process and write it as a Choupo case.

> **Version.** This document describes the development line `Choupo-dev`, which https://www.choupo.org/app runs and which every assistant document here describes.  The latest stable release is `Choupo-2608`; the one page that describes that release instead of the development line is the model catalogue, https://www.choupo.org/models/ (static copy: https://www.choupo.org/llm/models.md).

Two questions, one path each.  To answer whether Choupo does something (a unit, a calculation, a check), read the capability index: per concept it says what Choupo computes, what it only balances, what it only checks and what is missing, with a witness case.  To DESIGN a process, read the brief first and all of it: it is the contract for a case and ends with an index of task packs.  Read only the packs the design needs.  The reference documents are long and are for lookups a pack points to, not for reading end to end.

## Start here (the one entry; it routes every task)

- [start-here.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/start-here.md): read its first section and follow the route it gives

## Prompts to give the assistant (three short ones: learn Choupo, learn the area, the task)

- [prompts.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/prompts.md): Prompt for your AI assistant

## Does Choupo do X?

- [capabilities.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/capabilities.md): Capability index: does Choupo do X?

## Design a process: start here

- [brief.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/brief.md): Choupo assistant brief — read this first, all of it

## Task packs

- [batch-plant.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/batch-plant.md): Pack: a batch plant (tablets): batch plan, machines, clean utilities, quotes, crew
- [design-cost.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/design-cost.md): Pack: equipment sizing, costing and economics (CAPEX, OPEX, NPV)
- [layout.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/layout.md): Pack: plant layout (plot plan) and the GMP building interior
- [pharmaceutical.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/pharmaceutical.md): Pack: a tablet plant from a drug and a dose
- [pressure.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/pressure.md): Pack: pressure changers (pump, compressor, turbine, valve, pipe)
- [properties.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/properties.md): Pack: properties -- a component or a binary pair Choupo does not have
- [reactors.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/reactors.md): Pack: reactors and kinetics
- [recycles.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/recycles.md): Pack: recycles (loops in a steady flowsheet)
- [separations.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/packs/separations.md): Pack: separations (columns, absorbers, strippers, extraction, drums)

## Optional: reference documents

- [case-layout.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/case-layout.md): Case layout — the folders + files a case is made of
- [components.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/components.md): Standard catalogue — what ships in `data/standards/`
- [consistency.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/consistency.md): Data-consistency tests — *test the data, not just fit it*
- [curation-protocol.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/curation-protocol.md): Curation protocol — building a case *with the student* when data is missing
- [data-doctrine.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/data-doctrine.md): Data-governance doctrine — where every number lives, and why
- [dict-syntax.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/dict-syntax.md): Dict syntax — the language a Choupo case is written in
- [energy.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/energy.md): Energy: shaft work, heat duties, utilities, heat integration
- [extending.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/extending.md): Extending Choupo — writing your own code (and sharing it)
- [gui-credo.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/gui-credo.md): Choupo GUI Credo
- [membrane-research.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/membrane-research.md): Membrane research with Choupo -- a quick start
- [outer-drivers.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/outer-drivers.md): Outer drivers — the `system/outerDict` reference
- [overview.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/overview.md): Choupo — Overview for an LLM helping a user
- [patterns.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/patterns.md): Patterns — recipes for common case shapes
- [pitfalls.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/pitfalls.md): Pitfalls — common mistakes when authoring a Choupo case
- [schemas-reference.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/schemas-reference.md): Schemas reference — the shipped operations that carry a JSON schema
- [stream-state.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/stream-state.md): Stream state — what a `0/<stream>` file may say
- [thermo.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/thermo.md): thermoPhysPropDict — declaring the thermophysical system
- [unit-ops.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/unit-ops.md): Unit-op catalogue — every shipped type, what it does, how to write it
- [validating-against-data.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/reference/validating-against-data.md): Validating a case against measured data — and diagnosing what is wrong
- [models.md](https://www.choupo.org/llm/models.md): Choupo model catalogue (static; describes the stable release it names, not the development line)

## Optional: the project

- [Repository](https://github.com/choupo-admin/choupo): source, tutorial cases and data (GPL-3.0-or-later)
- [The app](https://www.choupo.org/app/): run a case in the browser
